When a murderous pack of vampires kidnaps his niece (Lily Collins), the priest breaks his sacred vows and sets out to rescue her before the bloodsuckers put the bite on her. Joining him on his quest are his niece's boyfriend (Cam Gigandet) and a former priestess (Maggie Q) with supernatural fighting skills.

videos.title: Serendipity
videos.description: On a magical night when they are in their 20s, Jonathan (John Cusack) meets Sara (Kate Beckinsale). He finds it love at first sight, but Sara believes in destiny. After 10 years the two -- with 3,000 miles between them -- must decide if fate wants them to be together again. When love feels like magic, it is called destiny; when destiny has a sense of humor, it is serendipity.

videos.title: McLintock!
videos.description: Aging rancher George Washington McLintock, a wealthy self-made man, is forced to deal with numerous personal and professional problems. Seemingly everyone wants a piece of his enormous farmstead, including high-ranking government men, McLintock's own sons and nearby Native Americans. As McLintock tries to juggle his various adversaries, his wife, who left him two years previously, suddenly returns. But she isn't interested in her husband -- she wants custody of their daughter.

videos.title: Any Last Words?
videos.description: Wounded and hovering between life and death, Bat Masterson (Tom Lagleder) revisits the choices he has made and how they have defined his life.

videos.title: Cheyenne Takes Over
videos.description: U.S. Marshal Cheyenne (Al "Lash" La Rue) and his sidekick, Fuzzy (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), are en route to a much-needed vacation at Fuzzy's friend's ranch. But, upon arriving, the partners find that Fuzzy's pal has been killed, and a fishy group of characters has taken over the ranch, claiming to have inherited it from the dead man. Immediately suspicious, the lawmen team up with local saloon owner Fay Wilkins (Nancy Gates), and forgo their vacation in favor of a murder investigation.

videos.title: Little Big Horn
videos.description: Captain Phillip Donlin (Lloyd Bridges) and his small troop must rush to reach Little Big Horn in order to warn General Custer of the Sioux attack that awaits him. As they race against time, and Donlin pushes them hard through an arduous and dangerous journey, the Sioux start taking out the soldiers one at a time. Meanwhile, Donlin also clashes with Lt. John Haywood (John Ireland), who Donlin knows is having an affair with his wife, Celie (Marie Windsor).

videos.title: McLintock!
videos.description: Aging rancher George Washington McLintock, a wealthy self-made man, is forced to deal with numerous personal and professional problems. As McLintock tries to juggle his various adversaries, his wife, who left him two years previously, suddenly returns. But she isn't interested in her husband -- she wants custody of their daughter.

videos.title: Driftin' River
videos.description: The cavalry asks cowboy Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) to inspect 300 horses they're looking to purchase from J.C. Morgan (Shirley Patterson), to assist the Army in battling outlaw attacks on railroad construction workers. Eddie and friend Soapy (Roscoe Ates) visit J.C.'s ranch, unaware that the attacks are being conducted by outlaw Marino (Dennis Moore), who owns the town saloon. Fearing the rail expansion will end his stage business, Marino attacks J.C.'s horses, and she turns to Eddie for help.

videos.title: Prairie Outlaws
videos.description: A retired singing ranger named Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and his friends Stormy Day (Al "Lash" La Rue) and Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates) are asked to jump back into the saddle to protect the construction of a telegraph line across the desert. However, a gang of ruthless thugs led by the villainous Drake Dawson aim to make sure that telegraph line doesn't stay up. In between the gunfights, ambushes, revenge and some valiant heroism, Dean sings a song or two.

videos.title: Stars Over Texas
videos.description: Cowboys Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates) have come to the end of a tough cattle drive, but, instead of the rancher they were expecting, they're welcomed by his sister, young Terry Lawrence (Shirley Patterson). It seems that Terry's brother and one of his employees were wounded by gun-toting thugs. Eddie and Soapy realize that they'll need to get to the bottom of things, so they devise a clever plan to lure the bad guys back to the scene.

videos.title: Black Hills
videos.description: When their father is shot by Dan Kirby (Terry Frost) after discovering a gold mine on his ranch, Larry Hadley (Steve Drake) and his sister, Janet (Shirley Patterson), ask foreman Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) for help in retaining their land. Eddie's arrival with sidekick Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates) disrupts Dan's plans to take over the property. Desperate to obtain the ranch, Dan blackmails accountant Tuttle (Bill Fawcett) into forging a document that will help him take control.

videos.title: Romance of the West
videos.description: Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean), along with his sidekick, Ezra (Emmett Lynn), oversees the peaceful coexistence of the Native American tribes with the white settlers of Antelope Valley. The treaty that binds the two groups is threatened when some of the town leaders learn that the Native American land contains rich deposits of silver. Eager to oust the tribes and claim the silver, the town leaders try to provoke an attack that would break the treaty. It's up to Eddie to stop them in time.

videos.title: West to Glory
videos.description: Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean), an undercover U.S. agent, is sent to a Mexican border town to protect the valuable Lopez diamond. One day he and his friend Soapy (Roscoe Ates) attend a party thrown by Don Lopez (Harry Vejar), a wealthy prospector who also holds large reserves of gold. After Lopez insists that the mysterious Maria (Dolores Castle) wear the precious gem, Eddie becomes suspicious that she may be in league with the gang that recently stole some of Lopez's gold and killed one of his men.

videos.title: Heart Wise Ministries - The Heart of Health
videos.description: The Heart of Health is a call in health program providing viewers with an opportunity to call in and get free medical advice from guests who practice medicine every day.

videos.title: Lineage Journey
videos.description: This series is designed to remind us of our lineage - what has come before that shaped us into who we are today. These riveting videos combine tightly scripted history lessons with breathtaking footage of actual Reformation sites to bring to life the realities of our Christian heritage. This series will inspire you with the sacrifices of our spiritual predecessors along with the providences of God in preserving His people and the freedoms we enjoy today. You will be motivated as never before to deepen your concecration to God and to finish His work on earth!

videos.title: SUMtv Stories
videos.description: SUMtv sits down with church members and ministry leaders as they share their testimonies of hope, redemption, and spiritual growth.

videos.title: SUMtv Sabbath School Hour
videos.description: Our weekly Sabbath School Hour is deisgned to help you strengthen your understanding of God's word as we go through the quarterly Sabbath School Lessons together.

videos.title: SUMtv Worship Hour
videos.description: SUMtv Worship Hour is a weekly series that features a variety of speakers who earnestly present deep, edifying sermons based on the Word of God. Each sermon offers a different message using biblical prophecy, Christian doctrine, the present truth, practical Christian living, and biblical teachings through the lens of history. Tune in to find encouragement for strengthening your faith, renewing your spirit and living in harmony with God's will.

videos.title: The Better Way
videos.description: Thinking about getting married but feeling discouraged by the current state of society? This series presented by Pastor Octavian Poenaru may offer some reassurance that with God's leading, healthy relationships can last and even be restored. Learn the short and long-term negative effects of marital conflicts, the main predisposing factor for conflicts and how to develop a strategy for solving them.

videos.title: Mind Wars - Eric Walsh
videos.description: In this three-part series, Eric Walsh exposes Satan’s attempts to distract us from the soon return of Jesus Christ through his subtle threats upon our generation. Though especially aimed at young people, this series offers a warning relevant to all ages.

videos.title: Anchor 2024: The Great Prophecies of the Old Testament Part II
videos.description: Anchor is a seminary-level course of study on the fundamentals of Seventh-day Adventist theology, taught by Pastor Stephen Bohr. The mission of ANCHOR is to settle students into the Truth both intellectually and spiritually and provide the theological skills to share with others the reason for the hope that is in them. Will your anchor hold in the coming storm?

videos.title: Equipping The Saints
videos.description: The church was never intended to be merely a social club for members but a training school for missionaries. This eye-opening series presented by Kameron Devasher will reveal God's original design for His people to be personally active in giving the gospel to the world, winning souls for His kingdom, and hastening the return of Jesus.

videos.title: The 24 Elders
videos.description: There has been much discussion in the Seventh-day Adventist church about the identity of the 24 elders. Some believe that they represent those who resurrected with Jesus. Others believe that they are the highest of angels. Who is this select group and what is their function in the heavenly courts? What lessons do they teach us regarding God's mode of operating the universe? These and other questions are clearly answered in this ground-breaking series.

videos.title: Misinterpreted Texts on the State of the Dead
videos.description: We live in a world captivated by the supernatural. Spiritualism has deeply influenced our media and entertainment. But what does the Bible actually teach about the state of the dead? Does the soul depart from the body at death? Are the righteous in heaven praising God? Are the wicked currently suffering in hell? In this enlightening series, Pastor Stephen Bohr explores these vital questions and more, offering clear, biblical answers about death and the afterlife.

videos.title: Silencing Satan
videos.description: Humanity has witnessed Satan’s relentless attempts to bring about destruction. In the face of such pervasive evil, sincere questions naturally arise - questions that may cause people to doubt God’s power, love, or even His very existence. This series confronts those challenging questions head-on, offering faith-affirming answers straight from God’s Word. Through hope and truth Satan can be silenced.

videos.title: The Best of I'd Like to Know
videos.description: The Best of I'd Like to Know revisits some of the series’ most compelling questions about the Bible, faith, and Christian life. Through Scripture-based answers and thoughtful discussion, these selected episodes invite you to discover timeless biblical truths, and deepen your understanding of God’s Word.

videos.title: SUMtv Sabbath School Hour
videos.description: Our weekly Sabbath School Hour is deisgned to help you strengthen your understanding of God's word as we go through the quarterly Sabbath School Lessons together.

videos.title: Unveiling Revelation - Pastor Carlos Munoz
videos.description: Have you found yourself wondering: What is going on in this world? If God is good how can he allow pain and injustice? In the limited understanding and infinite corruption of the world, we do not find answers that satisfy our souls. Only in God's Word and through the messages of Revelation can we find understanding, hope and peace.

videos.title: Come Out of Her My People
videos.description: Satan has sought to counterfeit God’s intimate gifts with self-centered indulgences, and sadly many have fallen for the deception. One of God’s most intimate gifts, sex, was created to foster deep connection within the covenant of marriage between a man and a woman. So how can we overcome sinful desires that go against His design? Not by our own strength, but by surrendering our thoughts to Jesus and allowing the Holy Spirit to transform our hearts.

videos.title: Jesus for Asia Faith Camp
videos.description: With every missionary stepping into the mission field, stories and miracles are bound to happen! Join us in this inspiring series as missionaries working with Jesus For Asia share those amazing stories and miracles! Whether you're looking for inspiration, a boost of faith, or simply a good story, this series will leave you moved and motivated.

videos.title: Father of the Bride
videos.description: George Banks (Steve Martin) and his wife, Nina (Diane Keaton), are the proud parents of Annie (Kimberly Williams), but when she returns from studying abroad and announces that she's engaged, their whole world turns upside down, especially that of overprotective George. From meeting the in-laws to wedding plans with an over-the-top consultant (Martin Short) and his flamboyant assistant (B.D. Wong), it seems as if the troubles never end in this update of the classic Spencer Tracy comedy.

videos.title: Fred Claus
videos.description: Of the two Claus brothers, Fred is the troublemaker and polar opposite of his saintly sibling, Nicholas. When Fred's criminal ways finally land him in trouble, Nicholas bails him out and brings him to the North Pole to work off the debt by making toys. The headaches mount for St. Nick, who must not only deal with his troublemaking brother, but also an efficiency expert, who has come to evaluate Santa's operation.

videos.title: Foul Play With Anthony Davis: Shorts
videos.description: Turning the tables on the locker-room dynamic, athletes from all sports pull pranks on their oblivious teammates and sports-world friends. The team behind Impractical Jokers helps them see the prank through from the opening tip-off to the final buzzer.

videos.title: Impractical Jokers
videos.description: The Jokers are back playing lawyers, trying to convince unsuspecting focus group participants to sign off on ridiculous terms and conditions before they go in. Then they put their family businesses to the test by asking strangers if their radio ad is good to stay on the air. Later, one joker will be getting revenge in an elaborate punishment that the other two are really going to feel.

videos.title: Impractical Jokers
videos.description: The Jokers are unsympathetic store managers, forced to throw out a disruptive customer before dealing with the wrath and disdain of fellow patrons; thus the guys must get a bystander to take their side during a heated argument with their fake spouses.

videos.title: Foul Play With Anthony Davis
videos.description: Anthony Davis pranks the NFL's Jayden Daniels and Braden Fiske during a senior-citizen fitness PSA that spirals when a fight breaks out; while NBA guard Zach LaVine sends MLB ace Blake Snell into chaos with a motion-capture session for a video game skin.

videos.title: Foul Play With Anthony Davis
videos.description: NBA star forward Tristan Thompson sends NBA superstar guard Darius Garland into an art auction disaster, and Anthony Davis sets up NFL defensive lineman Osa Odighizuwa for a business meeting interrupted by a streaker.

videos.description: Monica and Chandler fondly reminisce about London until a startling revelation leaves Chandler floored.

videos.title: Friends
videos.description: Joey is overjoyed to be nominated for a "Soapie" award; engaged Monica frets when she realizes she will never experience the thrill of a new relationship again; Ross spots Chandler sneaking out of a male strip club.

videos.description: Joey auditions for a big role which will require him to appear naked; Rachel and Phoebe plan Monica's bridal shower; Ross and Monica's attractive cousin visits and stirs the passions of all men who meet her.

videos.description: Ross becomes upset when someone at work takes his sandwich from the refrigerator and eats it; Joey finds himself in a mess when he tries to cover for Chandler and Monica's dating.

videos.description: Monica prepares a Thanksgiving feast for the gang, then becomes enraged when everyone shows up late; Phoebe convinces Rachel to enter Emma in a baby beauty contest.

videos.title: Four Christmases
videos.description: When their plans for an exotic vacation fall apart, unmarried couple Brad (Vince Vaughn) and Kate (Reese Witherspoon) must spend Christmas Day trudging around to a quartet of family get-togethers. While Brad counts the hours till he can escape the onslaught of crazy relatives, Kate begins to wonder about her own choices and ponders whether her family members are so crazy after all.

Then his childhood sweetheart, Kate (Thandie Newton), moves back to town, and he tries to figure out a way back to his true love.

Vail finds himself up against his ex-pupil and ex-lover, but as the case progresses and the Church's dark secrets are revealed, Vail finds that what appeared a simple case takes on a darker, more dangerous aspect.

videos.title: Jacob's Ladder
videos.description: After returning home from the Vietnam War, veteran Jacob Singer (Tim Robbins) struggles to maintain his sanity. Plagued by hallucinations and flashbacks, Singer rapidly falls apart as the world and people around him morph and twist into disturbing images. His girlfriend, Jezzie (Elizabeth Peña), and ex-wife, Sarah (Patricia Kalember), try to help, but to little avail. Even Singer's chiropractor friend, Louis (Danny Aiello), fails to reach him as he descends into madness.

videos.title: Distant Thunder
videos.description: A Chicago teenager (Ralph Macchio) searches the Pacific Northwest woods for his Vietnam-veteran father (John Lithgow).

videos.title: Before Dawn
videos.description: A young man joins his countrymen on the Western front of World War I, hoping to expedite an end to the bloody conflict. However, as the battle rages on, he's forced to grapple with the brutal realities of trench warfare, including a near-constant struggle to keep himself alive without leaving another man behind.

videos.title: The Terminal
videos.description: When Viktor Navorski (Tom Hanks), an Eastern European tourist, arrives at JFK in New York, war breaks out in his country, and he finds himself caught up in international politics. Because of the war, the Department of Homeland Security won't let him enter or exit the United States. He's trapped at JFK -- indefinitely. While living at the airport, Viktor falls for a flight attendant (Catherine Zeta-Jones). She may have feelings for him too. But what good is love if Viktor can't leave the terminal?

videos.title: You're Dating a Narcissist!
videos.description: A psychology professor who has a knack for spotting narcissists flies across the country to prove that the man her daughter is marrying is a fraud.

videos.title: The Comeback Trail
videos.description: Indebted to a mobster, a desperate producer tries to "accidentally" kill an aging movie star for an insurance scam. However, he soon begins to realize that the film they're shooting is a masterpiece in the making.

videos.title: Raging Grace
videos.description: Nothing is as it seems when an undocumented Filipina immigrant takes a job as a caretaker for a terminally ill man in a lavish home. She and her daughter soon become ensnared by a terrible secret that threatens to tear them apart.

videos.title: Scream 2
videos.description: Sydney (Neve Campbell) and tabloid reporter Gale Weathers (Courteney Cox) survived the events of the first Scream, but their nightmare isn't over. When two college students are murdered at a sneak preview of Stab, a movie based on the events from the first film, it's clear a copycat killer is on the loose. Sydney and Gail, as well as fellow survivors Deputy Dewey (David Arquette) and Randy (Jamie Kennedy) have to find out who is behind this new murder spree, before they all end up dead.

videos.title: Scream 3
videos.description: In the final installment of this trilogy, a murder spree begins to happen again; this time targeted toward the original Woodsboro survivors and those associated with the movie-inside-a-movie, Stab 3. Sydney must face the demons of her past to stop the killer.

videos.title: Scream 4
videos.description: It has been many years since the Ghostface Killer cut a deadly path through the town of Woodsboro. In order to get over the trauma of those horrific events, Sidney Prescott (Neve Campbell) has written a self-help book. She returns to Woodsboro for her book tour, and reconnects with old friends Gale Weathers (Courteney Cox) and Sheriff Dewey (David Arquette). However, Sidney's arrival also sparks the return of Ghostface, putting Sidney and everyone she loves in danger.

Entrevistas, acceso exclusivo detrás de bambalinas, conciertos y las últimas noticias de los artistas regionales más importantes del momento. Paulina Garcés, gran fanática de este género, conduce este programa de acceso total a los corridos. Un lugar para seguir de cerca las últimas noticias y videos de La Arrolladora Banda el Limon de Rene Camacho, Calibre 50, Roberto Tapia y Voz de Mando, entre muchos otros más.
